claims.text: US Patent 3,170,993, 'MEANS FOR AIDING HEARING BY ELECTRICAL STIMULATION OF THE FACIAL NERVE SYSTEM', names 'Henry K. Puharich, [street address omitted], Ossining, N.Y., and Joseph L. Lawrence', filed 8 January 1962 as Ser. No. 164,882, patented 23 February 1965, 24 claims. It cites the 1961 patent as prior work by the same inventors and adds a radio frequency receiver whose audio-modulated output is capacitively coupled to the nerve circuit through 'one or more cup-shaped dental caps'. No assignee appears on the face of the patent.
